text:
I want to give this clinic's doctor a good review. The mole on the bottom right corner had been treated with laser in China once, which was basically ineffective. I came to this clinic last October for treatment; the price was 2500 baht for two moles.

The mole on the bottom right corner was almost completely gone after one treatment. As you can see in the picture, it was due to hair growing from a follicle and some small amount of gray pigment deposition. Overall, I'm very satisfied; the mole is now smooth.

The mole on the top left corner was almost completely removed after one treatment, but there was still a tiny bit left. I had it treated a second time in January. The doctor didn't penetrate too deeply with the laser to avoid scarring, but a very small spot still remained. Today was my second touch-up treatment. This time, the doctor increased the laser intensity and told me that if it wasn't completely removed, surgical removal might be necessary. I won't do it again this time, regardless of whether it's completely removed or not, because I'm generally satisfied. The last two laser treatments were free.

The doctor is an elderly gentleman who only sees patients for a total of 4 hours each day, in the morning and afternoon, so remember to make an appointment in advance if you want to see him.

The price was extremely expensive, I never expected it to be this high. I saw the doctor for less than two minutes. The doctor asked if I had social security insurance and then prescribed three medications and a small topical cream. The doctor didn't give me any injections, but the medication alone cost thousands of baht. The price was shockingly expensive; I almost didn't have enough money. The medication lasted me a week, and I don't understand how they calculated the cost. If anyone is planning to go, I recommend bringing thousands of baht. I'm very disappointed; I read the reviews and thought it would be good.

text: I had a wart behind my ear that I wanted removed. At Memorial Hospital, I was first examined by a dermatologist (THB 1050). She told me that the wart could simply be cut off, but that she didn't have enough experience with it. Therefore, the dermatologist referred me to an ear, nose, and throat specialist, who also examined the wart (THB 850) and told me that he could cut it off immediately. Memorial Hospital quoted me THB 16,500 for the entire procedure, including the removal and examination! Because that was far too much for me, the doctor offered to remove the wart at his own private clinic for around THB 8,000-9,000. Since that was still too expensive, I searched online for an experienced dermatologist. There I read several positive reviews about Dr. [Name of dermatologist missing in original text]. Somnuek.
